import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    g = p[0] + p[1]*t + p[2]*np.sqrt(t) + p[3]*np.exp(-t) + p[4]*np.log(t)
    h = p[5] + p[6]*t
    k = p[7] + p[8]*t
    return g + h*P + k*P**2 + p[9]*P**3
